commit.message:
ci(#1856): limit the shard notice to what it knows; fix docs format (review)

Per review (the #1856 premise was too broad: the native lane runs most
crates' integration tests through their -test-windows-cross targets):
the skip notice and summary now say only that this cross shard's bazel
test step did not run and why, pointing to docs/ci.md; the docs bullet
keeps the cross-shard description and drops the 'no CI job' sentence;
the nightly line is reverted. The docs code span sits on one line
(Prettier 3.5.3 --check passes). Test assertions follow.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Signed-off-by: citadelculture <citadelculture@gmail.com>

files.patch:
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env python3
-"""#1856: the Windows gnullvm shard says plainly, when it skips, that Windows
-Bazel integration tests did not run, and docs/ci.md says no CI job runs them.
+"""#1856: the Windows gnullvm cross shard says plainly, when it skips, that its
+bazel test step did not run, and docs/ci.md documents the cross shards.
 Runs the detection step's own script with and without a key: its outputs (and
 so every later `if:` and the job outcome) are unchanged."""
 
@@ -38,6 +38,7 @@ def run_detect(key: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
             "BUILDBUDDY_API_KEY": key,
             "GITHUB_OUTPUT": str(output),
             "GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY": str(summary),
+            "SHARD": "3",
         }
         done = subprocess.run(
             ["bash", "-c", detect_script()], env=env, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True
@@ -47,13 +48,16 @@ def run_detect(key: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
 
 
 class WindowsIntegrationDisclosureTest(unittest.TestCase):
-    def test_skipped_shard_discloses_integration_tests_did_not_run(self) -> None:
+    def test_skipped_shard_discloses_its_tests_did_not_run(self) -> None:
         output, summary, stdout = run_detect("")
         self.assertEqual(output, "enabled=false\n")
         for text in (summary, stdout):
-            self.assertIn("integration tests", text)
-            self.assertIn("did NOT run", text)
+            self.assertIn("Windows gnullvm cross shard 3/4", text)
+            self.assertIn("bazel test step did NOT run", text)
+            self.assertIn("BuildBuddy", text)
             self.assertIn("#1856", text)
+            # Only what this shard knows: no claim about other lanes' tests.
+            self.assertNotIn("unit tests only", text)
         self.assertIn("::notice::", stdout)
 
     def test_authenticated_shard_is_unchanged(self) -> None:
@@ -67,11 +71,12 @@ def test_later_steps_still_gate_on_the_same_output(self) -> None:
         self.assertIn(f"if: matrix.shard == 1 && {gate}", text)
         self.assertIn(f"if: always() && !cancelled() && {gate}", text)
 
-    def test_docs_say_no_ci_job_runs_windows_integration_tests(self) -> None:
+    def test_docs_document_the_cross_shards(self) -> None:
         docs = DOCS.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
-        self.assertIn("no CI job\n  runs any crate's Bazel integration tests (`tests/*.rs`) on Windows (#1856)", docs)
-        self.assertIn("native Windows unit tests for every", docs)
-        self.assertNotIn("native Windows for every crate", docs)
+        self.assertIn("(`Bazel test on windows-latest for x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm shard N/4`,", docs)
+        self.assertIn("Without it every shard skips that step and still\n  reports success", docs)
+        # The nightly line is unchanged.
+        self.assertIn("native Windows for every crate", docs)
 
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":

@@ -213,13 +213,15 @@ jobs:
         shell: bash
         env:
           BUILDBUDDY_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.BUILDBUDDY_API_KEY }}
+          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
         run: |
           if [[ -n "${BUILDBUDDY_API_KEY:-}" ]]; then
             echo "enabled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
           else
             echo "enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
-            # #1856: say plainly what does not run. The job still succeeds.
-            disclosure="Windows Bazel integration tests (the *-windows-cross targets, crates' tests/*.rs) did NOT run: this gnullvm shard's bazel test step is skipped because authenticated remote execution (BuildBuddy) is unavailable, and the native Windows lane runs unit tests only (#1856). The native MSVC validation job remains mandatory."
+            # #1856: say plainly that this shard's tests did not run. The job
+            # still succeeds.
+            disclosure="Windows gnullvm cross shard ${SHARD:-?}/4: its bazel test step did NOT run because authenticated remote execution (BuildBuddy) is unavailable. The native Windows lane runs most crates' unit and integration tests; see docs/ci.md (#1856). The native MSVC validation job remains mandatory."
             echo "::notice::${disclosure}"
             if [[ -n "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY:-}" ]]; then
               printf '%s\n' "${disclosure}" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

@@ -50,13 +50,12 @@ red status noise without testing the code.
   one re-run (`--flaky_test_attempts`) for the intermittent #691 test. If that
   test fails both attempts again, add it to the skip list in `.bazelrc`'s
   `windows-native-tests` config.
-- Windows gnullvm cross shards (`Bazel test on windows-latest for
-  x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm shard N/4`, `bazel.yml` `test-windows-shard`),
-  meant to run the `*-windows-cross` targets: their `bazel test shard` step
-  runs only with authenticated BuildBuddy execution. Without it every shard
-  skips that step and still reports success, with a notice and job summary
-  saying so. Together with the unit-test-only native lane above, no CI job
-  runs any crate's Bazel integration tests (`tests/*.rs`) on Windows (#1856).
+- Windows gnullvm cross shards
+  (`Bazel test on windows-latest for x86_64-pc-windows-gnullvm shard N/4`,
+  `bazel.yml` `test-windows-shard`), meant to run the `*-windows-cross`
+  targets: their `bazel test shard` step runs only with authenticated
+  BuildBuddy execution. Without it every shard skips that step and still
+  reports success, with a notice and job summary saying so.
 - Argument comment lint on changed crates
   (`rust-ci / Argument comment lint - changed crates`, #636): runs the
   `/*param*/` lint, test code included, on every `codex-rs` crate whose `.rs`
@@ -103,8 +102,7 @@ block merges. Without a BuildBuddy remote cache these cold Bazel jobs take two
 to five hours, so they no longer run on every PR and get the 360-minute
 hosted-runner maximum:
 
-- Bazel test (Linux gnu and musl, and native Windows unit tests for every
-  crate; its integration tests are skipped as incompatible there, #1856), clippy,
+- Bazel test (Linux gnu and musl, and native Windows for every crate), clippy,
   and release-build verification.
 - Argument comment lint on Linux and macOS (Windows still runs on PRs;
   `rust-ci-full.yml` does not repeat it).
